tasks.label: Git: init och add

tasks.label: Git: commit
tasks.command: git -c user.name='nikeng-forenade' -c user.email='nikeng-forenade@users.noreply.github.com' commit -F captures/commit_msg.txt; git log --oneline -1

tasks.label: Git: commit och push
tasks.command: git add -A; git -c user.name='nikeng-forenade' -c user.email='nikeng-forenade@users.noreply.github.com' commit -F captures/commit_msg.txt; git push; git log --oneline -2

tasks.label: Git: ta bort kalibrering ur repot
tasks.command: git rm --cached calibration.json; Remove-Item -Force calibration.json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; git add -A; git -c user.name='nikeng-forenade' -c user.email='nikeng-forenade@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Kalibreringen ar platsspecifik och ska inte versionshanteras'; git push
